title: Export DynISF data
body:
Hello,
I had to replace the smartphone I use for AAPS but, exporting the configuration, the data relating to DynISF did not come up. The system has restarted data collection. Is there a way to also export the DynISF data?

comments.body: Data can be synchronised from Nightscout (Full Synchronisation cmd in NSClientV3 3-dot menu).

What do you mean by "DynISF data"?
- DynISF needs one week TDD to be able to work, but you can synchronize history within your new phone with NS
- if you have in mind DynISF values in secondary graph, it's within internal AAPS database in phone and I'm afraid there are no easy way to export to a new phone
